overview_description.description:
Inland Properties is a leading real estate company that was established in 2015. We aim to continuously redefine the real estate brokerage service to create a benchmark its main objective and goal is client satisfaction in the real estate business.

We pride ourselves on being the experts in luxury properties. This is a result of our devotion, passion, and dedication to serving the needs of buyers and sellers throughout New Cairo, 6th of October, Red sea and North coast.
